verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm. Its offerings are legal advisory services plus a few document-automation tools, such as the Contract Express-based SCC and term sheet generators. A law firm is not a software agent platform, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply. The Legora-based legal assistant collaboration is mentioned only in passing, with no tool or MCP integration described.
